title: Outside harvest survives a row without a git checkout and the baseline preflight ignores KRN worktree paths
body:
Why: outside rerun 1115i py plain: `node scripts/outside-acceptance.ts --stack py ...` crashed in harvestRows (scripts/outside-acceptance.ts:749-750 → repositoryRoot, src/brain/standards-cli.ts:158) with StandardsInputError "/mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside/runs/py-1794752669827 is not a git repository", exit 66, losing the harvest and summary for the run. Separately the lane preflight reported a red baseline: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest fails on a clean origin/outside/py (exit 1: FileNotFoundError: ... /runs/py-1794752669827/.krn/worktrees/t-0x3pmx6)` (.krn/runs/clause-proof/py-1115i.log:557-559) — the baseline test run depends on a lane worktree path that does not exist (pytest collecting or cwd inside .krn/worktrees?).
Outcome: (1) harvest skips (and reports) a row whose checkout is missing or not a git repository instead of throwing; (2) the baseline preflight never fails because of KRN's own .krn/worktrees paths: find whether pytest collects .krn/ (adopt should write testpaths/norecursedirs or the contract should exclude .krn) or the preflight runs in a not-yet-created worktree, and fix at the lowest layer.
Files: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts, src/cli/lane-run/preflight.ts, src/adopt/*, tests.
Proof: regression tests red before the fix (harvest with a non-git row dir; preflight/adopt case reproducing the FileNotFoundError on a py repo with a stale .krn/worktrees entry); outside py rerun drains past preflight.
